categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Hangke Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, research, manufacturing, and sales of lithium-ion battery post-processing systems. Its main products include various battery charge-discharge equipment, testing devices, logistics equipment, and supporting software systems. The company serves as a system integrator providing complete post-processing production lines for lithium-ion batteries, including cylindrical, pouch, and prismatic battery types.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies such as digital power supply, high-frequency PWM conversion, fully automatic calibration, high-temperature pressurized charge-discharge, high-precision linear charge-discharge, energy recovery, and DC bus distribution systems. It integrates MES, logistics scheduling, intelligent warehousing, chemical formation and grading management, 3D digital management, and machine vision technologies. Key innovations include 4680 series battery charge-discharge systems, high-voltage DC bus modules, vacuum and negative pressure formation technologies, and intelligent digital control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hangke Technology's key customers are leading lithium-ion battery manufacturers globally, including SK, Samsung, LG from Korea, BYD, CATL, EVE Energy, Guoxuan High-Tech, and Sunwoda from China, as well as Panasonic and Toyota from Japan. The company serves the electric vehicle, energy storage, and consumer electronics sectors, supplying equipment for battery production lines worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries and offices in Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Poland, the United States, Germany, Singapore, Hungary, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Malaysia. Its products are exported to major markets including Europe, North America, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangke Technology operates in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, specializing in manufacturing and supplying post-processing equipment for battery production lines. It provides integrated systems for battery formation, grading, testing, and logistics, essential for battery manufacturers to produce usable and high-quality battery cells and packs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on automation, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing. It invests heavily in R&D to develop advanced battery formation and testing equipment, energy recovery systems, and digital management platforms. Strategic directions include expanding into solid-state batteries, small steel shell batteries, and new materials, enhancing global market penetration, and promoting green and sustainable manufacturing practices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized lithium-ion battery post-processing equipment and integrated production lines. The company signs direct sales contracts with customers, delivering products followed by installation, commissioning, and acceptance to recognize revenue. It also provides after-sales services and software solutions related to battery production.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hangke Technology is a leading domestic manufacturer in China’s lithium-ion battery post-processing equipment sector, holding a significant market share and recognized as a benchmark enterprise. It competes with international giants like LG, Samsung, and Panasonic, maintaining strong partnerships with these companies. The company faces increasing competition due to market expansion and technological advancements but sustains its position through continuous innovation and global expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.98 billion, a 24.18% decrease from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 326 million, down 59.67%. Despite short-term declines due to market slowdowns and extended customer acceptance cycles, the company maintains a solid asset base of nearly RMB 9.77 billion and equity of RMB 5.16 billion. R&D investment increased to 8.63% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to long-term growth and competitiveness.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hangke Technology differentiates itself by offering comprehensive, integrated post-processing solutions for all major lithium-ion battery types, combining hardware, software, and logistics systems. Its products feature high precision, automation, energy efficiency, and environmental compliance. The company emphasizes customer-centric innovation, global service capabilities, and strong technical partnerships, enabling it to meet evolving market demands and maintain technological leadership.
